tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Retrieve the full ticket record: subject, body, submitter email, priority, created_at. Call this first on every ticket.

tools.name: lookup_customer_info
tools.description: Resolve a customer from either an email address or a customer_id. Returns customer_id, name, plan tier, tier_since, seat count, and SSO status. This is the only customer lookup you need.

tools.name: search_prior_tickets
tools.description: Search this customer's earlier tickets for related history. Returns an empty list when there is none — that is a valid answer, not an error.

tools.name: check_system_status
tools.description: Check whether a Meridian subsystem is currently degraded. Use it to rule out a platform-wide outage before treating a fault as customer-specific.

tools.name: spawn_specialist
tools.description: Hand one issue to the specialist who owns it. The specialist has the deep tools and does the actual resolution work. Call this once for EACH category the ticket raises — a ticket with an account problem and a billing problem needs two calls. Never call it twice for the same category.

category.description: billing = money; technical = integration/API; account = SSO, seats, permissions, 2FA.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Route an issue to a human when it needs authority, approval, or a judgement no specialist tool can provide — for example authorizing a penetration test, granting a contractual exception, or any request where no tool in the system can perform the action. Escalating is a correct outcome, not a failure.

summary_for_human.description: What the human needs to decide, and what has already been done.

tools.name: write_response
tools.description: Send the final customer-facing reply and close out the ticket. Call this once, last.

resolution_status.description: resolved = every issue the customer raised has an actioning tool call behind it; escalated = some issue went to a human; needs_info = blocked waiting on the customer.
